menu.service_notes: Passed bites for the first 45 minutes, then four stations. Hosted beer, wine, and one signature cocktail (Plover Spritz) from 18:00 to last call 21:00; spirits not included. Bar package [PACKAGE]; consumption beyond the package at [RATE]. Two bar stations, east and west walls. No raw bar in this sample.

items: citrus shrimp on cucumber (shellfish; offer a cucumber-melon alternative on the same tray for the 6 shellfish-free guests)
cheese and pickled-vegetable board, gluten-free crackers on a labeled tray
carved lamb shoulder and roasted cauliflower, herb yogurt on the side
dumpling station with a labeled gluten-free pan

bar.style: hosted beer, wine, and one signature cocktail
bar.location: Long Gallery east and west walls, two stations
bar.inclusions: beer, wine, and the Plover Spritz; spirits not included
bar.notes: Bar package [PACKAGE]; consumption beyond the package at [RATE].

dietary.note: tartlets, cauliflower, cheese board, dessert fruit; 8 of these are also vegan and use the vegetable and fruit labels only
labeled cracker tray and gluten-free dumpling pan

room_setup.style: standing reception with high-tops and a lounge cluster
room_setup.tables: 16 high-tops of 4 plus a lounge of 16; most guests standing
room_setup.other: See floor plan [ATTACHMENT]. Bars on the east and west walls, skirted in charcoal. Stations along the north wall, 8-foot minimum aisle. Escort-card and welcome table in the foyer, ivory linen. Charcoal high-top linen, ivory cocktail napkins, no overlay, no open flame. House seasonal branches only; no client florist in this sample. Standing capacity 180; seated high-top and lounge seats are 80 and are not the room cap.

items: house speakers for a client playlist
a spare wired mic at the landing
av.notes: No IMAG and no live band. Client delivers the playlist at load-in. Tech check 17:30. House operator only.

billing.notes: Master account: room, stations, passed bites, and [PACKAGE] hosted bar. Consumption beyond [PACKAGE] at [RATE]. [DEPOSIT] due on signing. Authorized signer [SIGNER]. Coat check not included.

notes: Synthetic sample only. Doors at 18:00. Quiet during the 19:30 remarks. Staff meal 16:30 in the service corridor, 16 meals.
